text:
## Purpose  
Establish procedures for processing customer address changes in a way that maintains regulatory compliance (KYC, AML, GDPR), updates all related systems and accounts, and minimizes disruption to customer services.  
---
name: Chunk 2/52

raw_entities.name: Customer Address Change Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for processing customer address changes while maintaining regulatory compliance with KYC, AML, and GDPR requirements. The process encompasses verification of new address information, system updates across all related accounts, and compliance checkpoint validation before finalizing the change.
context: Establish procedures for processing customer address changes in a way that maintains regulatory compliance (KYC, AML, GDPR)
updates all related systems and accounts, and minimizes disruption to customer services

raw_entities.name: KYC Address Verification Compliance Gate
raw_entities.description: Mandatory regulatory gate ensuring that address changes are verified and recorded in compliance with Know Your Customer obligations. This checkpoint validates that the new address meets KYC requirements before the process advances.

raw_entities.name: AML Address Screening Compliance Gate
raw_entities.description: Mandatory regulatory gate requiring AML screening of the new customer address against sanctions and PEP lists. This checkpoint ensures the address change does not trigger AML compliance violations.

raw_entities.name: GDPR Data Protection Compliance Gate
raw_entities.description: Mandatory regulatory gate ensuring that address change processing complies with GDPR data protection requirements. This checkpoint validates consent, data minimization, and retention obligations before updating customer records.

raw_entities.name: Customer Address Update
raw_entities.description: The new address provided by the customer during the address change process. This address must be collected, verified, and recorded across all related systems and accounts.
context: updates all related systems and accounts

raw_entities.name: Individual Customer
raw_entities.description: A natural person who initiates an address change request on their banking relationship. The customer is the primary party whose address information is being updated across all accounts and systems.

raw_entities.name: Address Verification
raw_entities.description: The Know Your Customer verification process applied to the new address provided by the customer. This verification ensures the address is valid, current, and compliant with KYC regulatory obligations.

raw_entities.name: Address Sanctions Screening
raw_entities.description: Anti-Money Laundering screening of the new customer address against sanctions lists and PEP databases. This screening is mandatory before the address change is finalized to ensure compliance with AML regulations.
